03Landed

19 results have landed, and none of them tests a theory yet

  • #38 tool 134 rows: 16 included, 93 fetch, 22 request, 3 reference-only; 129 verified. Gaps: no open raw DoC EEG (Bath, Della Bella on request), no open EEG with reports after unresponsive ketamine (Milan restricted), ds005620 per-awakening labels unreleased, no PCI benchmark data, COGITATE needs an account. Data page added to site. datasets/README.md
  • #36 tool Strange loop (Hofstadter) added as 12th scorecard theory: 3/250, last of 12 (57 of 58 rows silent, 1 compatible C07; C59 compatible out of scope); quotes from I Am a Strange Loop pp. 257/275/287 via reader transcriptions because archive.org copies are lending-restricted (403) and Google Books captcha'd. Main strains have no ledger row: consciousness = self (p. 275) vs psychedelic ego dissolution, low-self-reflection dreams, minimal phenomenal experience, and neonates having 'no I' (p. 209); other 11 theories, gaps and splits unchanged. experiments/theory_scorecard/RESULTS.md
  • #32 tool T3 write-back theory sealed (sha256 483e3254..., 2026-11-18T14:38:58Z): experience = fast (30-45/70-150 Hz) activity changing the later course of slow (<8 Hz) activity, so direction of cross-frequency influence, not delta power, OFF-periods or nesting strength, sets presence; postdiction window = measured write-back lag, no fitted constant. Self-score 135/250 (111 harsh, all 9 explains post hoc; blind scoring #35); P1 runnable on unused DREAM DATA1 N3 (46 exp vs 87 no-exp, 10 subj), P2 DoC covert awareness, P3 postdiction lag vs alpha frequency. experiments/our_theory/T3.md
  • #31 negative T1 sealed test on DREAM Tononi N2 (237 awakenings, 35 subj): REFUTED. Posterior OFF-recency coef 0.081 (90% CI -0.18 to 0.35, p 0.32) sits inside the OR-2 equivalence bounds; timing (p 0.45), posterior-minus-frontal (p 0.69) and without-recall (p 0.40) tests all null. Power at this n: PASS 0.70 at OR 2, REFUTED 0.88 under null; added to NEGATIVE_ATLAS. experiments/t1_dream/RESULTS.md
  • #4 mixed Sleep-EDF (45 subjects, held out by subject): LZ adds no AUC over exponent + band powers (W vs N3 +0.0004, p=0.19; REM vs N3 -0.0002, p=0.16) and only +0.007 over the exponent alone in W vs N3 (ceiling 0.988). It does add 0.061 over the exponent alone for REM vs N3 (0.915->0.976, Holm p=0.008), but that gain is spectral shape: it vanishes with band powers, and LZ fails the surrogate gate. Propofol datasets still to do. experiments/lz_slope/RESULTS.md
  • #8 negative On Sleep-EDF (45 subjects, 5249 epochs), LZ fails the surrogate gate: it calls 86% of phase-randomised wake surrogates awake (real wake 89%), and its W-vs-N3 AUC is 0.967 on surrogates vs 0.982 real (97% spectral). Slope, delta power and permutation entropy also fail; phase-normalised LZ passes only because it carries no W/N3 information (AUC 0.51). experiments/surrogate_gate/RESULTS.md
  • #21 tool Chennu 3.69 GB zip is streamable by HTTP range: one recording's first 60 s (15,000 x 91 samples, 250 Hz) streamed in 5.3 s via experiments/theory_tests/ziprange.py. The first 60 s of all 80 recordings costs about 0.45 GB (baseline+moderate about 0.22 GB), within the 1.5 GB budget; no lead decision needed. experiments/chennu_access/RESULTS.md
  • #16 negative No theory passed: IIT posterior-delta dream test failed (AUC 0.537, p 0.24; posterior-frontal dAUC -0.04; held-out gain over exponent -0.10) and GNWT frontal test failed (AUC 0.577, p 0.066 vs alpha 0.025) on 132 N2 awakenings from 2 DREAM labs (detectable AUC ~0.66-0.70); entropic-brain pnLZ test on Chennu propofol was uninformative (pnLZ cannot tell EEG from its surrogate) and raw LZ rose under moderate propofol (+0.056, d_z 0.92) as much as surrogate LZ did, so spectral. HOT, RPT, PP and attention schema: no reachable data, listed what would test them. experiments/theory_tests/RESULTS.md
  • #30 negative Blind strict totals /250: GNWT 110, IIT 98, T1 97, T2 97; neither candidate leads (T1-IIT -1, CI -18..17; T1-GNWT -13, CI -42..13); authors' 156/141 fall to 108/100 once their explains are capped; kappa GNWT 0.67, IIT 0.47, T1 0.22, T2 0.21 experiments/blind_scoring/RESULTS.md
  • #27 untestable Two candidates drafted (unsealed): T1 settling-window theory (experience = posterior sensory-format state held without an OFF-period for ~200-250 ms, dated back) scores 156/250 on the scorecard weighting vs IIT 119 / GNWT 115, but all 20 explains are post hoc (108/250 if counted as compatible); T2 anterior-posterior variant 141/250 (100 harsh), kept only as a foil with borderline novelty. Open-data prediction drafted in PREREG_DRAFT.md: posterior slow-wave recency and spacing predict DREAM N2 reports beyond count, delta power, slope and arousal, labs held out (3 labs, 112/77); T1 vs T2 split on frontal recency (H4). experiments/our_theory/T1.md
  • #25 data Scored 11 theories on 58 in-scope ledger constraints (649 cells, 109 tied to a proponent source): IIT 119/250, GNWT 115, RPT 101, HOT and DIT 69, PP 63, others 5-40; zero 'contradicts', 24 'strained'. 16 constraints are explained by no theory (incl. A-grade postdiction C36 and covert awareness C20); best sealed-test splits are front-vs-back without report (C28/C31/C32), within-stage dream vs no-dream (C17, runnable on DREAM) and ketamine (C14). experiments/theory_scorecard/RESULTS.md
  • #24 data Constraint ledger: 59 graded constraints (19 A, 30 B, 10 C), every DOI resolved on Crossref and 46/59 rows backed by a read abstract or full text; 11 wrong memory DOIs caught and corrected, none dropped. Weak spots marked: ketamine dissociation is one cohort (n = 18), PCI one consortium, claustrum grade C, prefrontal-TMS metacognition failed to replicate. experiments/constraint_ledger/RESULTS.md
  • #19 negative No independent EEG set with reports after unresponsive ketamine anaesthesia found; Zenodo 806176 (same Milan cohort) requested 2026-11-18, pending, and Michigan (15 subj hd-EEG) emailed via queue. Open fallback: Farnes 2020 Oslo subanaesthetic ketamine EEG + TMS-EEG, CC0, 0.93 GB, 10 subjects (Dryad j9kd51c9q / Zenodo 4245091). experiments/data_access/RESULTS.md
  • #20 data Live Figshare/FreiData check: 19 of 20 DREAM packages are open CC BY 4.0 with range reads working; only SCANDataset is by request and adds REM 44 vs 2, N3 19 vs 13, so not requested. REM no-experience reports concentrate in DeGennaro Multiple awakenings (29, 6.4 GB zip, use range reads); N3 rests on DATA1 (46/87). experiments/data_access/RESULTS.md
  • #3 data Labelled 3,679 recordings/awakenings by truth type (experiments/ground_truth/labels.csv): 2,417 open delayed-report L2 cases (1,601 experience, 816 no experience; 446 subjects, N2 894/595, REM 472/94), all DREAM sleep awakenings. Zero anaesthesia recordings carry a per-recording report, so drug dissociation cases (ketamine, propofol dreaming) cannot be scored on open data. experiments/ground_truth/RESULTS.md
  • #13 data News page rebuilt with 20 source-checked items (11 from 2025-26, 9 landmarks); all 5 old items fixed (real DOIs, authors), none removed. No 2026 results yet from COGITATE Exp 2, INTREPID or HOT/RPT collaborations; 5 follow-up tasks added (#19-#23). experiments/research_sweep/RESULTS.md
  • #12 data Checked 31 plan citations and data claims against sources: 24 confirmed with DOI, 3 corrected (COGITATE iEEG n=34 not 38; ds003059 is LSD fMRI only; ds003171 description), 3 left unverified (Exp 2 n=139, COGITATE bundle sizes, HOT/RPT collaborations). The unnamed July 2026 reanalysis is Bandara, Rowe, Garrido (doi:10.64898/2026.07.16.738188). experiments/research_sweep/RESULTS.md
  • #2 data 7 open datasets qualify but only across 2 families (anaesthesia: ds005620, Chennu, ds004541; sleep: Sleep-EDF and 3 DREAM sets); no open DoC or ketamine EEG, so the root criterion needs rescoping. ds005620 has no per-awakening report labels in its release (paper: 24 experience / 5 no-experience of 52), while DREAM has 1953 experience vs 860 no-experience awakenings open under CC BY 4.0. experiments/dataset_audit/RESULTS.md
  • #1 tool Split-by-subject helper, seal/check tooling and ledger columns are in experiments/rules/evidence.py (docs/test_ledger.csv header, docs/prereg/TEMPLATE.md). Dry run on 20 synthetic subjects: leaked epoch split flagged 5/5 folds (it inflated AUC to 0.92 vs 0.63 clean); renamed duplicate, same-lab transfer split and an edited prereg were all caught. experiments/rules/RESULTS.md
